_meta.rule: A row is a base-freight candidate when source != 'global' AND (is_base_freight === true OR (NOT vetoesBaseName(row) AND isBaseSurcharge(name))). vetoesBaseName: source in veto_sources OR lower(leg) in veto_leg_tags. The stamp wins over the veto (SB-5501); globals never claim the freight slot (SB-2854).
_meta.why: A broker's manual charge named like a base row ('Drayage', 'Ocean Freight', 'Freight') or a charge the save path tagged to an accessorial bucket is an add-on, never the freight row. Name-only, the webapp hid it and dropped it from the total while the add-in billed it (W4201Y, ETV1I0, 21a88608, 72a7ecbd, 7e174a48). The add-in never anchors freight on a manual (buildManualSurchargeSaveRow).
_meta.consumers: apps/webapp/lib/constants/__tests__/surchargeCategories.test.ts (vetoesBaseName / isBaseFreightRow), apps/backend/tests/unit/internal/rfq_v2/test_leg_freight_price.py (vetoes_base_name / is_base_surcharge_row), apps/public-api/domain/base_freight_test.go (IsBaseFreightLine).
